visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a white ribbed crop top and blue denim jeans, stands on a paved sidewalk. She holds a small black DJI wireless microphone close to her mouth. She is smiling and gesturing with her hands towards the camera. The background shows a storefront with a large poster of a bubble tea drink and a closed metal shutter with graffiti patterns. (2) The scene transitions to a vertical screen recording of a mobile application interface. A prominent pop-up window for Google Maps' "Real-time location sharing" feature is displayed over a simplified map view. The UI elements, including buttons and information text, are in Traditional Chinese, positioned over a clean white background with a large red Google Maps pin icon. (3) The screen recording continues, showing the user navigating from an iPhone home screen adorned with multiple cute puppy wallpapers to the Google Maps application. The user interacts with the app by tapping a blue location dot, opening a sharing menu, and then sliding a timer to adjust the sharing duration between various intervals like 1 hour and 7 hours. The bottom share sheet is visible with common social media app icons. (4) The footage returns to the woman on the street sidewalk. She is pointing her index finger towards the viewer and smiling broadly while walking slightly forward. The urban setting behind her features storefronts, signs, and typical street architecture under bright, even lighting. Her body posture is open and energetic, complementing her direct address to the camera. (5) The woman suddenly turns her head to the left, showing a surprised facial expression with widened eyes. A cartoonish "burning fire" graphic overlay appearing as a frame around her is used for comedic emphasis. She responds to an off-screen interaction with a sharp, witty look. The background remains the same outdoor city environment with high-contrast cinematic lighting.

The content concludes with a humorous interaction to maintain audience engagement while providing practical utility.
